content.title: Vodacom inks Africa internet deal with Musk's Starlink
content.summary: South Africa's largest mobile operator Vodacom Group has signed an agreement ​with Elon Musk's Starlink to deliver high-speed,‌ low-latency broadband internet for businesses across Africa, the telecom ‌firm said on Wednesday. Despite Vodacom's footprint of over 223 million customers, rural Africa remains a tough frontier. Sparse populations, difficult terrain, and low smartphone penetration make ⁠traditional tower rollouts ‌costly.
